name: EngageBay Marketing Automation for LearnDash
author: engagebay

sections.description:
Connect your LearnDash LMS courses with EngageBay CRM effortlessly.
Automatically sync students, trigger marketing automations, and boost engagement with zero manual work.

How to Use

  1. Enter your EngageBay API Public Key and Private Key in the settings page.
  2. Choose preferences of your choice to trigger EngageBay actions.
  3. Set up actions like tagging, list assignments, or CRM field updates.
  4. Build automations inside EngageBay based on synced data.
  5. Watch your user engagement grow automatically!
sections.installation:
1. Navigate to Plugins → Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Search for “EngageBay Add-on for LearnDash.”
  3. Click Install Now and then Activate.
  4. Go to LearnDash LMS → Settings -> EngageBay to configure your API settings & Preferences.
sections.faq:
Do I need an EngageBay account?

Yes, you must have an EngageBay CRM account to use this plugin.

Does this work only with LearnDash?

Yes, this plugin is specifically designed for LearnDash LMS.

Can I automate email campaigns based on course activity?

Absolutely! You can trigger EngageBay automations when a user enrolls or completes a course.
